name: omni-progress
description: Live turn progress in the status line, and a warning when a tool call runs long or keeps failing the same way.

slowCallMinutes.title: Slow call threshold (minutes)
slowCallMinutes.description: Warn once when a single tool call has run this long.

repeatFailures.title: Repeated failures
repeatFailures.description: Warn when the same tool fails this many times in a row with the same input.

watchBash.title: Watch Bash calls
watchBash.description: Also observe Bash. Off by default: any tool.call hook matching Bash breaks subagents spawned with isolation: worktree (Claude Code bug #92533).
